name: Eeyok Dougenis
source:
It's the 1700's and you're engaged to the duke, but suddenly... you're executed for a crime you didn't commit?!

You wake up to find out you've been sent back into time. You're a modiste again, tailoring clothes for nobles. But not for long though, as someone will discover your special lineage, causing the duke to propose to you again, pulling you into the world of high society.

This time, you learn from your mistakes and will try to avoid your execution by making friends and allies along the way.

[From [url=https://celianna.itch.io/tailor-tales]Itch.io[/url]]
